method: Opened and visually inspected these actual online Playwright screenshots with view_image after the successful deployment. This supplements DOM assertions; it is not MP4 playback review.
observations: 390px MQ directory shows only one EP.10 MQ intro, one published lesson, an independent viewing description, a single MQ breadcrumb, and a v0.80.0 footer. Text, controls and layout fit the viewport.

1440px content library has both direction and series set to MQ, displays 1 of 48 items, and shows the original EP.10 intro card with the unchanged poster and original dates. No systems/peak category is displayed for that card.
scope: Canonical-origin browser pages and real interactions used urllib responses with the configured CA validation; HTTPS verification remained enabled. The helper cache reuses downloads, so 57 networkResponses means actual distinct fetch entries, not all browser requests. Three MP4 Range responses were incidental browser preload, not playback verification.
